description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kimbulapitiya, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511208 (23/0911)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding three specific land parcels (07:01, 07:02, and 07:03) in Kimbulapitiya. It includes detailed land particulars such as parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications, making it clearly a land-related matter falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
